snippet.title: Cattails: Wildwood Story — Steam Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Cattails: Wildwood Story is pouncing onto Steam October 20! ✨
✅ Wishlist us now & enter the Wildwood soon: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1882500/Cattails_Wildwood_Story/

In Cattails: Wildwood Story, players will create their very own kitty cat and roam the lands of the Wildwood in search of prey to hunt and herbs to forage while attracting new cat residents to join their town. While getting to know their neighbors, they may even fall in love and raise a family of kittens with one of over twenty eligible partners. When a dark presence threatens their new home, the player must rise to the challenge and root out the corruption that lies at the heart of the Wildwood.

Cattails: Wildwood Story began development in September 2019. In May 2022 a Kickstarter campaign concluded with over $240,000 in backer support, smashing its goal and ending with over 800% funding. Since then a small closed beta playtest group has seen regular monthly updates with new features, stretch goals, and plenty of surprises added to the game along the way.

Lead developer Tyler Thompson says, “We are thrilled to finally welcome players into the Wildwood. After four years of continual development, we believe Cattails: Wildwood Story is a strong new entry in the Cattails series. Fans of cozy games, wholesome games, cats, and RPGs will find a lot to like in our latest offering.”

Cattails: Wildwood Story arrives on Steam on October 20, 2023. A Nintendo Switch™ release is scheduled for 2024.

For more information, visit our website at https://cattailsgame.com

Press Kit: https://cattailsgame.com/presskit/sheet.php?p=cattails_wildwood_story

Genres: Single-player, life sim, RPG, survival, dating sim

-Key Art: Baban Illustration
-Logo Design: Denise Hohl
-Concept Art: Mari-Liis Kirsimägi
-Music: Tormod Garvin, Naomi Sullivan, Alex Hill-Knight
-Character Portraits: Narabas Artworks
-Voice over: Rebekah Thompson
